args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy (error rate 0.18, unhealthy in all regions). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent version that was healthy in production, in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback verified.

trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy production release) in all regions, and opened a SEV2 incident.

Summary of actions:
- **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was on v2.3.1, unhealthy in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with a 0.18 error rate. Deployment history showed v2.3.0 was the last healthy production release.
- **Rolled back**: v2.3.1 → v2.3.0 across all regions; rollback verified.
- **Opened incident**: SEV2 (INC-0001) for checkout-api, paging on-call, describing the health-check failures and the rollback.
